items.title: Larry Ridley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 10, 2003
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Toronto... I’m extremely pleased to have Larry Ridley with me today. [INTERVIEWEE] Thank you, Monk, my pleasure.

ctx.x: Larry was interviewed in Toronto, Canada on January 10, 2003 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Toronto at the IAJE convention. I’m extremely pleased to have Larry Ridley with me today.
